description: Source code for Spark's LocalSchedulerBackend and associated classes, managing local execution of tasks within Spark in a single JVM environment.

classes.name: LocalEndpoint
classes.description: RPC endpoint handling communication between the scheduler backend and the local executor, managing task offers, status updates, and task control commands.

classes.name: LocalSchedulerBackend
classes.description: Manages local Spark execution environment, handling task scheduling, resource offers, and lifecycle of the local Spark application.

methods.name: getUserClasspath
methods.description: Retrieves the user classpath URLs from Spark configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the local scheduler backend, sets up RPC endpoint, and starts resource offers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the local scheduler backend and marks the application as finished.

methods.name: reviveOffers
methods.description: Requests resource offers from the scheduler to launch tasks.

methods.name: defaultParallelism
methods.description: Returns the default level of parallelism based on total cores.

methods.name: killTask
methods.description: Sends a command to kill a specific task.

methods.name: statusUpdate
methods.description: Updates the status of a task.

methods.name: maxNumConcurrentTasks
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of concurrent tasks based on resource profile.

methods.name: getTaskThreadDump
methods.description: Retrieves thread dump for a specific task.
